title: custom 3d totem pack
description: a totem of undying thats your own skin that pops up when you die
body:
# 🌟 Features
* **3D Model:** A completely custom-made 3D model for the Totem of Undying.
* **Vanilla Style:** Designed to fit perfectly with Minecraft's default textures.
* **Low Impact:** Optimized model that won't lag your game.

# 🛠️ How to Use
1. download your skin from namemc or other
2. Open the ZIP file and navigate to:
`assets/minecraft/textures/item`
Replace the existing `totem_of_undying.png` with your own skin (rename your skin to `totem_of_undying.png` first!).
3. add the ZIP file into minecraft
4. enjoy!
5. change the desc, photo, and name by first right clicking the file and clicking rename and change the name to whatever you want and second to change the desc go inside the folder and locate pack.mcmeta and change it to what ever you want and lastly to change the photo locate pack.png and change the picture and also you needed to copy paste the photo only and notes

# 📝 Notes
* This pack is a **Resource Pack**, not a mod.
* It works on versions [Insert your version, e.g., 1.20.2] and above.
* Feel free to use this in your modpacks!
